title: Apartment 22, Longford House, IFSC, Dublin 1, D01FE06
seoTitle: Apartment 22, Longford House, IFSC, Dublin 1, D01FE06
description:
Herbert & Lansdowne are delighted to present Apartment 22, Longford House, IFSC, Dublin 1, to the market.
This impressive two-bedroom apartment offers a superb opportunity to acquire a modern, energy-efficient home in the heart of Dublin’s vibrant IFSC. 

Extending to approximately 62 sq. m., the property is A-rated, providing excellent energy efficiency and contemporary city living.
Located within this popular residential development, the apartment offers well-proportioned accommodation comprising an entrance hallway, spacious open-plan living and dining area, a modern fitted kitchen, two bedrooms, and a main bathroom. The generous living space provides an ideal setting for both relaxing and entertaining, while the A-rated energy performance is an attractive benefit for both owner-occupiers and investors.

The IFSC is one of Dublin’s most established residential and commercial districts, with an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, shops and everyday amenities close by. The apartment is also exceptionally well served by public transport, with the LUAS, Dublin Bus and Connolly Station all within easy reach, providing convenient access throughout the city and beyond.

The property’s central location makes it particularly appealing to professionals working within the IFSC, Docklands and Dublin city centre, while its proximity to Trinity College, Grand Canal Square and the wider city centre further enhances its appeal.

Key Features:
 Spacious two-bedroom apartment
 Approx. 62 sq. m.
 B-rated BER
 Modern city-centre accommodation
 Well-proportioned living and bedroom accommodation
 Excellent public transport connections
 Highly convenient IFSC location
 Ideal owner-occupier or investment opportunity

Viewing is highly recommended and is sure to appeal to those seeking a modern, energy-efficient apartment in a prime Dublin 1 location.
